status: post-review exploratory protocol; public prospective registration not claimed
known_exposure: All original 2017 results and C10 joint-gradual shrinkage 50/10/1 are already inspected. No 2018 forecast performance inspected.

statistical_plan.estimand: equal scenario/horizon mean NWIS; paired original row eligibility
statistical_plan.equivalence: Post-hoc symmetric availability-relative margins 5%, 1%, 0.5%; confidence-interval inclusion with 95% intervals is conservative versus usual 90% TOST; 5% original physical gate is not treated as prespecified equivalence
statistical_plan.multiplicity: Simultaneous Bonferroni 98.75% intervals for four producing-site/phase contrasts; block-length sensitivity; no selected significance claims

feature_plan.selection: fixed ablation matrix; no test-based feature selection

fault_plan.weather_proxy: observed POA / max(100,1000*solar_sine) in fault generator only; not a claim of a physical storm mechanism

decision_plan.q80: linear interpolation between issued q75 and q90, labeled interpolation
decision_plan.scope: illustrative one-hour energy commitment; no realized market prices, storage or joint-trajectory claim

additional_sources.NIST_2018: attempt acquisition; require each month >=70% paired daylight and near-idle diagnostics before forecasts; retain failed screen
additional_sources.independent_sites: public AC and POA data, metadata and cadence qualification before any forecasting; preserve failures

public_data_requirement: Archived NWP must identify initialization and publication latency. Reanalysis is not a forecast. Receipt/backfill logs require measurement and reception timestamps; do not infer them from gaps.
